# HyperLap2D Wiki

> Documentation for HyperLap2D, a free and open source 2D game editor with a libGDX runtime. Website: https://hyperlap2d.rednblack.games/

Every page below is also available as raw Markdown at the linked URL. The rendered site lives at {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/.
